summary: The repository is public, so RunPod pod accounting and limits leave it (owner decisions of 2026-10-02). pod_control.py had committed each campaign's full ledger (the account balance on every dispatch, committed spend, the cap and each pod's rate) and carried each campaign's ceiling and the balance floor in source. Every ledger event now goes to a private ledger under ~/.runpod/accounting/ and, as an allow-listed projection (pod ids, code refs, image, plans, times, export digests), to the repository; rates and host machine ids stay private. The budget reads the private ledger and refuses when the repository holds a row it lacks, and recording a termination is never refused. Ceilings and the floor come from the operator's ~/.runpod/campaigns.json, without which nothing that spends runs. Figures print only with --show-accounting. The exam-design and EV4 ledgers are migrated row for row, and a test refuses any committed ledger field outside the allow-list. Balance lines and spend totals in narrative documents are redacted; frozen pre-registration sections, pinned records and historical Hub events are unchanged, and a history rewrite awaits the owner. No scientific, qualification, reward or LIVE authority changes.
